about.text: Yakult is a Japanese sweetened probiotic milk beverage fermented with the bacteria strain Lacticaseibacillus casei Shirota. It is sold by Yakult Honsha, based in Tokyo. The name "Yakult" was coined from jahurto, an Esperanto word meaning "yogurt".

how.text: A single strain, L. paracasei Shirota, slowly sours a heat-treated sweetened skim-milk base into a concentrate. This is homogenised, mixed with syrup and diluted into a thin, sweet drink.

steps.note: Skim milk powder, sugar and dextrose in water.
L. paracasei grows best at 30–38 °C, so the fermentation is long and makes acid but little aroma.
Blended with sugar syrup and flavour.
